status: Declared before numerical diagnostic execution; reused development evidence only. Not a new policy or parameter choice.

scope.price_family: the saved nine candidates; risk_first is a label, not an infinite fitted eta

diagnostics.definition: For every job and beta: n, original target/gamma/case, reference annual kB, floor(beta*n+1e-12), min(kB,floor), saved dynamic minK, count gap, feasible orders, selected order and all feasible growth ties in one global1e-12 band. Reconcile with saved full training path records. Group raw floors, effective caps, feasible sets and chosen orders separately; do not invert an observed rejection into a proposed beta.

For each context, group beta values by the complete saved per-original-validation-path vector of job/case/status/admission/selected order. Same vector identifies the same already frozen selected deterministic controllers, because target/fan are beta-independent within each job. Separately group complete saved financial metrics; equal aggregate means alone are insufficient. Record empirical eligibility, coverage and canonical smallest-beta choice; no population identifiability claim.

Within each training job compare the nine saved candidate path outcome vectors and per-beta objective ties. If full saved metric vectors coincide, call only recorded-outcome equivalence; unselected training action traces and Q states were not retained, so do not infer identical actions or identify a continuous eta. Different outputs distinguish grid candidates on this training support only. Risk-first remains a separate lexicographic label.

All24 inner/refit pairs: preserve ID sets, size, static gamma, Q1 assignment, target weights/IDs and target L1 change. For each beta compare cap/minK/gap and selected order. Algebraic gap change=minK change-cap change is not a causal attribution; the minimizing price can also change.

At each fixed nominal candidate order, using saved training outcomes only: k_refit-k_inner=(refit events on retained IDs - inner events on retained IDs)+refit events on newly added IDs, with upward/downward event flips and all ID witnesses. Inner T is subset of refit S. The controller is endogenous to both target and training fan; common market path does not mean common state/policy. No new outcome for rejected outer paths.

Use only frozen H30 annual-policy MDD cache. For each inner/refit target pair compute four k(T,target_inner),k(T,target_refit),k(S,target_inner),k(S,target_refit) and their retained/added counts. Report target-first and addition-first algebraic decompositions and their interaction; these are fixed-annual-cache contrasts, not attribution of dynamic controller risk.

boundaries: No parameter, tie, admission, coverage or liquidity rule will be changed here.

Static risk-only/Q2 Balanced-only case distinctions remain as saved.
